title: Mock isGrafanaDevMode directly, not via utils or config.buildInfo
answers: How do I mock the dev-mode check in plugin extension tests?
jest.mock('./utils') no longer toggles dev mode for extensions tests
How to simulate development vs production mode in usePluginComponent/usePluginLinks tests
body: Symptom: tests that mutate `config.buildInfo.env` to switch dev/prod behavior in plugin-extensions code stop having an effect. Root cause: isGrafanaDevMode (public/app/features/plugins/extensions/isGrafanaDevMode.ts) was extracted out of utils.tsx into its own leaf module to break a circular import; registries (AddedComponentsRegistry, AddedFunctionsRegistry, AddedLinksRegistry, ExposedComponentsRegistry, Registry) and hooks (usePluginComponent, usePluginComponents, usePluginFunctions, usePluginLinks, validateExtensionPoint) now import it from that file, not from ./utils. Fix pattern: `jest.mock('./isGrafanaDevMode', () => ({ isGrafanaDevMode: jest.fn().mockReturnValue(false) }))` and toggle per-test with `jest.mocked(isGrafanaDevMode).mockReturnValue(true/false)`, rather than mocking ./utils wholesale or setting config.buildInfo.env.
applies: public/app/features/plugins/extensions/** tests that depend on dev vs production behavior
